تستهلوا (form X)
# تَسْتَهِلُّوا (tastahillū) /tas.ta.hil.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# تُسْتَهَلُّوا (tustahallū) /tus.ta.hal.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
